_about: The story's chapters, in order. Each mission file says which chapter it belongs to with "part" (1 = the first here). Every name and line in the story is original.

parts.title: The Graduation
parts.summary: A new genin, a loud rival, and an academy vault that should never have been opened.

parts.title: The Ashen Trail
parts.summary: The thief's clones lead west across the sea, to a burned valley and an old student.

parts.title: The Windward Watch
parts.summary: A hunter from the Watch names what sleeps in the scroll's last seal.

parts.title: The Old Dam
parts.summary: Stone, water and a ritual circle the size of a valley.

parts.title: Kagerou's Reason
parts.summary: A road through the snow, a duel on the thief's terms, and the truth about an accident.

parts.title: Nue
parts.summary: The new moon over the Five Winds, and the technique no one has used in a hundred years.
